Definition: A key, or keys pressed together, that does an action right away.
A key held down with another key to change what it does, such as Control, Command, Alt (Option on Mac) or Shift.
Turning an item left or right, like shaking your head no.
Tipping an item up or down, like nodding your head yes.
Tilting an item to one side, like tilting your head toward a shoulder.
How large an item is compared to its normal size. A scale of 1 is normal size.
When moving an item makes it jump from one grid line to the next, so items line up.
Quorum Studio's list of which key does each action. It can be changed.
